note: Owner's corrections for campaign tracking (tools/campaigns.py, CLAUDE.md 5cu). Detection works without this file. Keys of 'campaigns' are any member id of a campaign (an MC number such as MC1426371, a main-list item id, or the campaign id c-...): name, summary, type, tech, keywords (extra phrases that pull articles and videos in), changes (What changes rows: change, before, after, src), todo (rows: text, src), pin, hide. 'merge' lists groups of member ids that belong to one campaign. 'components' adds a Learn version table to a component of Component versions. 'define' lists campaigns the owner defines by their posts and items (id, name, tech, type, summary, keywords, members); a post listed by two definitions is shared and its dates, rows and actions are split by each definition's keywords. 'settings' holds how long campaigns stay on the page and the priority thresholds (days and scores; any key left out keeps the default in tools/campaigns.py).

entra-connect-sync.name: Entra Connect Sync — version support
entra-connect-sync.summary: Every Entra Connect Sync 2.x version retires 12 months after a newer version ships; below the supported version synchronization can stop. Read from Microsoft's version-history table and joined with the version the brief tracks in Component versions.

define.name: Microsoft-provided SMS and voice MFA retirement
define.summary: Microsoft stops delivering one-time codes by text message and phone call for MFA and password reset. A tenant moves its users to other methods (passkeys, Microsoft Authenticator, FIDO2 security keys) or configures a third-party telephony provider; SMS as a first factor (sign-in with a phone number instead of a password) retires for workforce tenants as well.

define.name: Passkeys by default in Microsoft Entra ID
define.summary: Microsoft makes passkeys the default registration and sign-in experience in Entra ID: passkey or passwordless sign-in as the first MFA method, passkeys for B2B guests issued by the resource tenant, an optimised registration campaign and passkey profiles.
